Oathlight Strike

You speak your oath and bring your weapon down in a flash of light. Part of that light gathers beside a companion, catching the next threat in its glow.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Speak the promise that guides your hand and strike with a melee weapon.

- Weak: 2 physical and 1 radiant damage. - Standard: 2 physical and 1 radiant damage; one ally adjacent to you gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. - Strong: 3 physical and 2 radiant damage; one ally adjacent to you gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn and may move 1 square without provoking.

Duration: Until the start of your next turn; a next-roll benefit ends when used.

Equipment / acquisition: Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Radiance 1

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: oathlight-strike
